slave 1 replied to "Read Coils": 16 bit states, 2 ON / 14 OFF (details below)

Note: the response frame carries no start address or quantity; numbering starts at 00001 by default and the last byte may contain padding bits — refer to the matching request

── Byte-by-byte ──
01     Slave address  device 1
01     Function code  0x01 = Read Coils
02     Byte count     2 data bytes
05 00  Data           each bit is the state of one coil (LSB first within each byte)
F7     LRC check      LRC check passed

── Technical details ──
Transport: Modbus ASCII (6 decoded bytes)
Slave address: 1
Function: 0x01 (Read Coils)
Byte count: 2
Data: 05 00
LRC: 0xF7 (passed)
PDU: 01 02 05 00
